labelled_by: Claude-labelled (pass 18, 23 Sep 2026) from the lab transcript; replace with his corrections when an exported report exists.
notes: Lab copy 4,470 s (podtrac/Megaphone). The Spreaker ad-free mirror (4,344 s, similarity 0.986, build/lab/badf1.dai.json) shows three inserted spans: the Disney+ Mandalorian pre-roll (0:00-0:30), the same spot again mid-roll (23:44-24:15), and a 66 s Porosos vodka post-roll (1:13:24-end). Inserted edges are scored against those frame times.

Every other ad is a host read recorded into the episode, in two breaks: Warby Parker + Cash App (20:58-23:44, directly before the inserted Disney+ spot, so one break of three) and NOCD + Ultra + Hungry Root (43:13-47:17). This matches the five sponsors the show notes list.

How each cut was judged: a read starts at its first sponsor words and ends at the last line of the offer (URL, code or disclaimer). The Warby Parker hand-off falls in a 3.4 s gap the recognizer left mostly empty ('...are you telling you about Warming Parker'), so that start has 3.5 s of slack. Hungry Root's last words ('...with our code. Bad friends.') share a recognizer line with the next conversation, so the end sits 1.1 s early, inside tolerance.

INTRO is the produced opener of voice clips ('You two are bad friends... Who are these two idiots... We're bad friends') at 2:39, after the unscripted start of the conversation; judged from the wording, not heard.

After the sign-off ('Thank you for being a bad friend. There it'll do', 1:12:59) come about 25 s of wordless credits music before the inserted post-roll. It has no words to anchor, so the post-roll carries 26 s of start slack and OUTRO as an alternative label: cutting from the end of the talk is right.

Brand mentions left as conversation (NORMAL): 'had blue chew' (16:04, a joke), the Sunny's cheesesteak, Regal/IMAX, Nathan's and Coca-Cola, the Keebler elves, the Hulu special talk (52:38), Starbucks, Lime scooters. The fan-art thank-you at 0:53 is a shout-out, not a plug. No Patreon, tour or merch plug is spoken in the audio.
